info.title: haulNX
info.author: digdat0
info.description: A ROM library manager for emulators
info.details: A ROM library manager for Nintendo Switch homebrew. HaulNX builds and maintains one central library at sdmc:/roms/<console> you fill it from your legit backup sources, and it keeps that library organized, verified, and tidy. It checks against No-Intro/Redump DATs, deduplicated, misfiled files sorted, folders per console. Point your emulators at sd:/roms once and everything you add shows up. It also keeps your installed emulators and apps up to date from GitHub, and ships with a companion you run on your PC.

changelog:
v2.1.0 adds box art from SteamGrid and Accent colors.
v2.0.0 adds library verifiaction against No-Intro/Redump DATs, native RAR3 support and integration with desktop app
v1.1.2 adds Install a game straight from your PC, plus a live verify progress bar.
v1.1.0 adds per-console install folders, a live speed test, and a much wider console list (53 total)
